project_info.theme: Three red-carpet looks for a playful ginger-haired adult model
project_info.color_palette: copper red, pink, black, blue denim, silver, crystal and deep red

main_subject.detail: Clearly adult red-haired fashion model presented in three distinct editorial looks: a Y2K black tube top with blue denim and pink butterfly clips; an ethereal silver crystal bodice with tulle elements and windblown ginger hair; and a structured deep-red gown with a single shoulder strap and geometric cutout details. Expressions range from playful side glance to joyful motion and soft serious gaze.
main_subject.style: photorealistic red-carpet fashion series with paparazzi flash and polished lookbook consistency

composition_elements.layout: three-look editorial series with each outfit and pose clearly separated
composition_elements.background: pink carpet with paparazzi for look one, dark gala background for look two and a black fictional step-and-repeat for look three
composition_elements.text: Remove Getty Images watermark and replace repeated logos with fictional neutral event marks.

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: direct paparazzi flash for look one, polished gala lighting for look two and event flash for look three
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: consistent realistic hair, crystal, denim and gown texture across a playful high-fashion series

technical_specs.optics: portrait lens, sharp styling details and controlled background blur

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic editorial series featuring a generic clearly adult red-haired fashion model in three distinct red-carpet looks. Look one is Y2K pop: copper-red long loose waves with a center part and two pink butterfly clips, a black strapless tube top, blue denim jeans, a silver rhinestone choker and a black studded belt, leaning forward with a playful side glance on a pink carpet amid blurred paparazzi. Look two is high glamour: vibrant ginger-red windblown crimped waves, a silver bodice with intricate crystal and bead embroidery and tulle skirt elements, turning over her shoulder with a radiant joyful smile against a dark blurred gala background. Look three is modern elegant: deep-red soft waves swept over one shoulder, a structured red gown with a single wide shoulder strap and tasteful geometric cutout details, standing straight with hands clasped at the waist against a fictional black step-and-repeat. Preserve the adult model's ginger hair identity across looks, fashion silhouettes, lighting and red-carpet energy. Use realistic texture, direct flash or gala lighting as appropriate, sharp subject detail and polished lookbook continuity. Remove watermarks and recognizable celebrity or sponsor identity.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, watermark, recognizable sponsor logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, inconsistent face across looks
